origine_fr: À gauche, 豸, le fauve ; à droite, 勺, qui donnait le son mais se lit sháo. C'est une bête comme le tigre, mais aux taches rondes. C'est le léopard, la panthère.
origine_en: On the left, 豸, a wild beast; on the right, 勺, which gave the sound but is read sháo. It is an animal like the tiger, but with round spots. It is the leopard, the panther.
